profileImage.label: Profile logo or avatar
profileImage.usage: Provider logo/avatar on provider profiles, cards, dashboards, messages, and bookings.
profileImage.guidance: Use a square logo or clear headshot. Keep important text or marks centered.

profileCover.label: Profile cover image
profileCover.usage: Wide Pro cover image at the top of provider profiles.
profileCover.guidance: Use a wide brand or work image. Keep important details near the center because mobile crops the sides.

serviceImage.label: Service image
serviceImage.usage: Service cards on provider profiles and service detail pages.
serviceImage.guidance: Use a real photo of the finished work, team, or outcome. Avoid text-heavy posters.

galleryImage.label: Gallery image
galleryImage.guidance: Square images display most predictably in the profile gallery.

portfolioImage.label: Portfolio image
portfolioImage.usage: Portfolio project cards on provider profiles.
portfolioImage.guidance: Use a clear project/result image with the subject centered.

postImage.label: Post image
postImage.usage: Provider posts in the public feed, provider profile posts, and post detail pages.
postImage.guidance: Landscape images work best for posts and feed cards.

storyImage.label: Story image
storyImage.usage: Provider story cards, story tray previews, and full-screen story viewer.
storyImage.guidance: Use portrait images. If you upload a poster or landscape image, ServicePros fits the full image inside the story box with a blurred backdrop.

articleImage.label: Article image
articleImage.guidance: Use wide explanatory images that support the article.
